Vitamin A activity, retinol equivalent (µg). This is retinol equivalents (RE), not retinol activity equivalents (RAE) -- different quantities that can differ by up to 2x for carotene-rich foods (RE historically used a 1:6 beta-carotene:retinol ratio; RAE uses 1:12). The aggregate RE figure cannot be converted to RAE without the underlying carotene breakdown, so it is dropped rather than stored under vitamin_a_rae; retinol and carotene_beta are mapped individually instead.
